using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using Ferrule.Generated;
using Ferrule.Runtime;

uint inputNode = uint.Parse(args[0]), outputNode = uint.Parse(args[1]);
foreach (var (input, output, expected) in new (string?, string?, string?)[] {
    (" ./input.hl7 ", " ./output.json ", null),
    (null, "output.json", "InputFile"),
    ("input.hl7", null, "OutputFile"),
    ("*.hl7", "output.json", "wildcards"),
    ("input.hl7", "", "nonempty"),
    ("input.hl7", "*.json", "wildcards")
}) {
    var parameters = new Dictionary<string, FerruleValue>();
    if (input is not null) parameters["InputFile"] = FerruleValue.FromString(input);
    if (output is not null) parameters["OutputFile"] = FerruleValue.FromString(output);
    var execution = FerruleExecutionContext.WithParameters("mapping.json", new FerruleRuntimeParameters(parameters));
    var host = new Host();
    try {
        var bytes = GeneratedMapping.ExecutePrimaryEdiDocumentBytes(execution, host, 1);
        if (expected is not null) throw new Exception("expected filename refusal");
        if (!JsonNode.DeepEquals(JsonNode.Parse(bytes), JsonNode.Parse("{\"label\":\"blue widget\",\"units\":\"7\"}"))) throw new Exception("complete output differs");
        if (GeneratedMapping.EvaluateOutputFilename(execution) != output) throw new Exception("output filename changed");
        if (!host.Calls.SequenceEqual(new[] { "select:" + input, "load:" + input })) throw new Exception("transport changed");
    } catch (FerrulePrimaryDocumentException error) when (expected is not null && error.Error == FerruleDocumentAcquisitionError.Filename) {
        if (host.Calls.Count != 0) throw new Exception("host called before filename refusal");
        if (error.InnerException is null || !error.InnerException.Message.Contains(expected) || error.Path is not null || error.Count is not null) throw new Exception("wrong filename error details", error);
        bool missing = expected is "InputFile" or "OutputFile";
        uint node = expected == "InputFile" || input == "*.hl7" ? inputNode : outputNode;
        if (missing) {
            if (error.InnerException is not FerruleRuntimeException runtime || runtime.Error != FerruleRuntimeError.MissingRuntimeParameter || runtime.RuntimeParameter != expected || runtime.Node != node) throw new Exception("wrong missing parameter details", error);
        } else if (error.InnerException is not GeneratedMapping.FilenameEndpointException invalid || invalid.Node != node) throw new Exception("filename error identity changed", error);
    }
}

var valid = FerruleExecutionContext.WithParameters("mapping.json", new FerruleRuntimeParameters(new Dictionary<string, FerruleValue> {
    ["InputFile"] = FerruleValue.FromString("input.hl7"), ["OutputFile"] = FerruleValue.FromString("output.json")
}));
foreach (int count in new[] { 0, 2 }) {
    var host = new Host { Count = count };
    try {
        GeneratedMapping.ExecutePrimaryEdiDocumentBytes(valid, host, 3);
        throw new Exception("cardinality admitted");
    } catch (FerrulePrimaryDocumentException error) when (error.Error == FerruleDocumentAcquisitionError.DirectSelection && error.Count == count && error.Path is null && error.InnerException is null) {
        if (!host.Calls.SequenceEqual(new[] { "select:input.hl7" })) throw new Exception("loaded invalid cardinality");
    }
}
var malformed = new Host { BadInput = true };
try {
    GeneratedMapping.ExecutePrimaryEdiDocumentBytes(valid, malformed, 1);
    throw new Exception("invalid EDI admitted");
} catch (FerrulePrimaryDocumentException error) when (error.Error == FerruleDocumentAcquisitionError.Input && error.Path == "input.hl7" && error.Count is null && error.InnerException is FerruleEdiException { Code: FerruleEdiError.Format }) {
    if (!malformed.Calls.SequenceEqual(new[] { "select:input.hl7", "load:input.hl7" })) throw new Exception("input failure transport differs");
}

sealed class Host : IFerrulePrimarySourceHost {
    public List<string> Calls { get; } = new();
    public int Count { get; init; } = 1;
    public bool BadInput { get; init; }
    public IReadOnlyList<string> Select(string filename, FerrulePrimaryFileSelection selection) {
        if (selection != FerrulePrimaryFileSelection.Direct) throw new Exception("selection changed");
        Calls.Add("select:" + filename);
        return Enumerable.Repeat(filename, Count).ToArray();
    }
    public FerruleCsvSourceData Load(string request) {
        Calls.Add("load:" + request);
        return new FerruleCsvSourceData(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(BadInput ? "not an HL7 message" : "MSH|^~\\&|\rABC|blue widget|7\r"), null);
    }
}
